# Winamp Video Maker

> Browser-based tool that turns audio into Winamp-style videos. Pick a classic skin, add tracks, set a background, and export MP4 or transparent WebM up to 4K.

- [Editor](https://winamp-video-maker.vercel.app/): create and export a video
- [Marketplace](https://winamp-video-maker.vercel.app/marketplace): browse skins
